title: Jagged Bitter Mexican Baby Squid Tacos
description: A nostalgic Mexican dish featuring bitter and chewy baby squid, shaped like nigiri, in a low sodium taco.

ingredients.name: baby squid
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into small pieces

instructions: Rinse the baby squid under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, garlic, oregano, cumin, and salt-free seasoning blend.
Add the baby squid to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Remove the squid from the marinade and shape into small nigiri-like pieces.
Grill the squid for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few pieces of grilled squid onto a tortilla, followed by a sprinkle of chopped cilantro, sliced radishes, and diced bitter melon.
